note: Axis 3 (Liquidity & Exit), single producer. MEASURED 2026-09-22 per chain, no cross-chain scalar. syzUSD = Staked Yuzu USD; FOUR deployments at four different addresses, resolved on-chain; Sei's is unmeasurable (no router endpoint), not absent -- see enumeration.correction_2026_09_22. Measured exit evidence only; no risk score.

depth.slippage_convention: Per-chain marginal execution-rate deterioration from each chain's smallest successful $1,000 rung; signed cost. No cross-chain scalar is computed.
depth.basis: NOT MEASURED AS ONE NUMBER, by design: four deployments with no shared book (Sei unmeasurable: no router endpoint), so a cross-chain scalar is refused. Per chain: Monad (11.9M supply) is the only executable exit, crossing 2% marginal at [$201,953 - $203,711] with proceeds capped near $205K; Plasma (55.6M, 73%) has no route at any size; Sei (8.44M, 11%) has no venue or router endpoint and is unmeasured; Ethereum (276K) dust only. The asset's secondary exit, in total, is roughly $205K of csUSDC on Monad.

market_price_cross_check.note: ⚠️ THE TWO MARKS DISAGREE BY 250bps AND BOTH ARE LIVE. The published mark is the SMALLER Monad pool ($106,572 reserve, $0.00 traded in 24h); routing reaches the 3.5x larger csUSDC pool. Against NAV that is 0.072% versus -2.431% — so the headline discount depends on which venue you call the market. Two pools 3.5x apart quoting one asset differently, unarbitraged, IS the liquidity finding; it is published rather than resolved by picking a side.

quote.method: KyberSwap GET /api/v1/routes exact-input syzUSD -> the chain's deepest USD stable, measured independently on each chain; no cross-chain scalar

plasma.reading: 55.6M of the 76.3M syzUSD supply (72.9%) is on Plasma and the router finds NO ROUTE to USDT0 at any size ($1K-$10M). The only DEX presence is two Pendle PT/SY pools ($71K, not a spot exit) and a $14.8K Balancer v3 syzUSD/USDT0 pool the router does not reach. This is a finding about the asset: the dominant deployment has no executable secondary exit.
